name: Group-IB Threat Intelligence
description: Group-IB Threat Intelligence analyzes and attributes cyberattacks and supports threat hunting and network protection with data on adversary tactics, tools and activity. Use this pack to receive incidents relevant to your organization, attribute them to threat actors and malware, enrich your security tools with Group-IB indicators of compromise, and investigate Group-IB data from Cortex XSOAR.
